name: Pactiv Evergreen - Malvern AR
type: Manufacturing Plant (Food Merchandising; polystyrene foam food tray converting; ISCC PLUS certified)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via 2023-01 Street View showing a blue 'PACTIV' silo/tank and the plant's office front on Industrial Lane, plus the company sign post at the driveway. Web search corroborates the polystyrene-foam-tray plant at 1105 Industrial Lane, Malvern AR (~160 employees, plant manager Bruce Deer). The roster geocode (moved 290 m) lands on the western half of the main plant building; locked center moved to the building cluster centroid.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence rings the property along Industrial Lane (confirmed in three 2023 Street View headings). The SE driveway entrance has a rolling/sliding gate panel in the fence line with the Pactiv sign beside it - a controlled truck gate. truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the gate or anywhere along the entrance in any Street View heading. The office front is part of the main building, not a standalone booth. guardShack false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: There IS a controlled gate but NO guard booth, implying kiosk / call-box / badge check-in. remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gated driveway runs 80+ m from Industrial Lane into the plant yard and dock apron - room for a 3+ truck queue inside the fence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South building face has a dock bank with ~12-15 trailers backed in (clear in z19 satellite); additional dock bays on the east building. Total estimated 18-25, banded 10-25. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large paved trailer drop yard south of the south dock bank holds rows of parked drop trailers; a second paved trailer/container storage yard sits along the NW edge. Counted ~45 trailers; banded 50+ for capacity-class drop activity.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated paved trailer-storage lots on the south and NW of the plant, separate from active dock staging - dropYard true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The site is a campus of 3+ large connected/adjacent industrial buildings (main converting plant, north building with rooftop equipment, east building) on one fenced property - multipleFacilities true.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is well off-site. Rail not served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small-town Malvern AR; the area immediately south is a low-density commercial/residential strip (Greyhound stop, small stores). Edge-of-small-town industrial - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box (~470 m N-S x ~350 m E-W of the fenced multi-building property and yards) yields roughly 33 acres - estimate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single gated driveway; entry and exit share the one opening. Lane counts are estimates.
